study_identification_part.si_4_title: Normative trajectories of R1, R2*, and magnetic susceptibility in basal ganglia on healthy ageing

answer: ABRIM healthy ageing cohort (260 participants, ages 18–79 years)
Personalized Parkinson Project (PPP) cohort for validation (44 healthy controls, 316 Parkinson's disease patients)
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: ABRIM provides the primary normative dataset for qMRI trajectories; PPP supplies an independent cohort with healthy controls and PD patients for external validation.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "resulting in data of 260 participants to be included in the statistical analysis (18- 79 years; mean ± standard deviation (SD) = 50.8 ± 16.8 years" ... "PPP study ... was used ... data from 44 healthy volunteers and 316 patients were used."

answer: ABRIM cohort: Normative training dataset to derive Gaussian Process Regression trajectories of R1, R2*, and magnetic susceptibility in basal ganglia.
PPP cohort: Independent validation set applying the ABRIM-derived normative models to healthy controls and Parkinson's disease patients.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: ABRIM establishes normative qMRI trajectories; PPP cohort with matched protocol is used to test applicability and examine deviations in controls vs Parkinson's disease.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "Normative trajectories ... derived ... using a healthy ageing cohort comprising 260 subjects" and "To study the applicability ... an independent cohort ... Personalized Parkinson Project (PPP) ... was used."

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: ABRIM normative sample includes 260 healthy adults. PPP validation provides 44 healthy controls alongside PD patients; all 44 controls are used for validation.
